evidence.t: Unnamed wetland, 1.4 ha, 140 m from the road.
About 15 wetlands within 2 km (estimate): ducks move between them.
Beside Puntledge River: backwater or oxbow (estimate).
Elevation 138 m: under 900 m, open water later in fall.

flags.t: Route crosses private land (ParcelMap BC, updated 2026-09-22): get permission first or go around.
Private land 150 m S: no shooting within 100 m (109 yd) of an occupied house or farm building (synopsis page 10, 99%).

plan: Drive: from Village of Tofino, about 105 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.64242, -125.09986, pull off on Comox Lake Mainline (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 180 m N, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Jan, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 1-6, Region 1. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-22, closures 2026-10-16.
R1A-duck-drive-0003.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 1-6: about 17,292 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 4.31 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.2 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
